[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Agroverse invoice hardening — TrueTech Inc issuer stamp + Wise pay link (INV-20260911-BP)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1021
  
  Details:
  Worked the "record sale of cacao to Elizabeth Wong / BionPact" thread end-to-end on behalf of Gary Teh.
  
  WHAT SHIPPED
  1. Invoice INV-20260911-BP — rendered, iterated across 5 governor corrections, final archived to store_interaction_attachments/invoices/bionpact-invoice-20260911.pdf (commit dfcf15d).
     - Issued by TrueTech Inc (Delaware C-Corp, EIN 88-3411514), signed Zhiwen Teh (Gary Teh), President
     - Billed to BIONPACT PTE. LTD., UEN 202620924G, 33 Ubi Avenue 3 #08-34, Singapore 408868
     - 40 kg Oscar Fazenda organic cacao beans, lot AGL14, Ilheus warehouse — USD 800.00
     - Payment: Wise pay link (card / bank-wire / Wise balance) + Venmo @garyjob fallback; Stripe removed
     - Boxed exclusion: shipping NOT included, buyer arranges own freight (e.g. DHL)
     - PII stripped: individual name, email, initials and named-nothing filename all removed
  
  2. Root-cause fix — agentic_ai_context PR #1021 (MERGED, squash b43305d): AGROVERSE_INVOICE_CONVENTION.md previously specified the invoice title as the BRAND ("Agroverse Cacao") and said nothing about the issuing legal entity or EIN, so all three prior invoices (green-gulch, melinda-larios, chives-root) went out with no entity and no EIN. PR adds a mandatory "Issuing entity" section (default TrueTech Inc block incl. EIN/CBP importer no./signatory), takes the issuer legal name as the title, and requires legal name + EIN + address in the footer with the officer's name/title on the signature.
  
  3. Entity research — established that BIONPACT PTE. LTD. is a real Singapore trading entity (UEN 202620924G, ACRA acknowledgment 24 Aug 2026, registered office via Osome/Prima), NOT merely the agent persona. Found it only by searching the gary Gmail; it exists nowhere in agentic_ai_context.
  
  EVIDENCE
  - agentic_ai_context PR: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1021
  - Invoice archive: TrueSightDAO/store_interaction_attachments invoices/bionpact-invoice-20260911.pdf (commits 7bc5f0c, 59c225b, 80fb003, 4b35672, dfcf15d)
  - Entity source: fda_fsvp/truetech_inc.entity.json (TrueTech Inc EIN 88-3411514); gary-mailbox ACRA/Corppass/Osome correspondence (BionPact UEN 202620924G)
  
  OPEN (flagged, not done)
  - No email sent — sendable draft parked in admin mailbox, awaiting a BionPact recipient address (no BionPact mailbox exists)
  - BIONPACT PTE. LTD. should become a first-class entity record alongside truetech_inc.entity.json
  - Superseded drafts + old named archive PDF not removed (no Gmail delete tool exposed)
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
